name: @nuxeo/satori-cli
description: The one builder of a customer's Nuxeo Satori configuration: validate and build a configuration package of Layer 0, Layer 1, assets, version 1 layouts and version 2 app definitions into its Marketplace zip, hold it to what it was, pull a server's content model, and scaffold a configuration repository. Built into plain JavaScript that needs Node alone. Not published: publishing waits for decision K.
